info.title: INSEE Melodi (official statistics)
info.description: Keyless INSEE dissemination API. observations[] each carry dimensions.GEO ('2026-COM-80021') and measures.OBS_VALUE_NIVEAU.value. Census 2023 and Filosofi 2023.

get.summary: Median standard of living and poverty rate (Filosofi 2023)
get.description: FILOSOFI_MEASURE=MED_SL (median niveau de vie, EUR/yr) or PR_MD60 (poverty rate %, 60% of median). Small communes may carry no value (statistical secrecy).

parameters.name: GEO
parameters.description: Geography: '<vintage>-COM-<insee>' (e.g. 2025-COM-80021), '<vintage>-ARM-<code>' for a Paris/Lyon/Marseille arrondissement, or a bare level ('COM') for every commune.

get.description: IMMI=1 immigrants (born abroad, not French at birth), 0 non-immigrants, _T total. Use SEX=_T&AGE=_T&EMPSTA_ENQ=_T for totals.
